name: Blue Dragonborn

traits.name: Displaced Voice
traits.description: As an Action, cause your own audible vocal sounds to seem to originate from a point of your choice within 30 feet. You can use this ability at will while speaking during that Action. It creates no image, damage, or other sound effects, does not automatically imitate another creature's voice, and does not guarantee successful deception; observers can use the ordinary rules for observation and attempts to identify an illusion.

reviewNotes: Inherits shared Dragonborn and nonselectable Chromatic family traits via explicit stable parent IDs.
